none: PAS CAM-25AA84: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Constans or Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constans or Constantius II. AD348-350, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads FEL TEMP REPARATIO. Reverse shows Phoenix on globe. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.04g, diameter is 16mm
